summary: NASA Administrator Jared Isaacman has issued a new Planetary Protection Directive, leading a series of major civil space developments as the agency awards a contract to develop lunar 5G communications, opens the 2027 Human Lander Challenge, and selects new science investigations for a planned Moon base. In national security space, the White House nominated Miller to lead U.S. Space Command as a new military report highlights that the Space Force requires laser communications to clear severe data bottlenecks. Internationally, Artemis Accords partners are preparing to confer on lunar debris management while NASA and foreign partners advance joint research on space crops. The commercial space sector saw significant funding and technical milestones, including Varda securing $251 million in Series D financing, Hop Aero raising $11 million for suborbital delivery, NaviGate demonstrating precise orbit determination aboard a D-Orbit satellite carrier, and SpaceX completing the first orbital test flight of its Starship rocket. In space science, astronomers linked mysterious cosmic flashes to colliding dead stars, discovered a hidden star cluster in the Milky Way's disk, and determined that Earth and Mars were built from distinct cosmic recipes. Skywatchers should look forward to a rare lunar occultation of Jupiter alongside Saturn reaching opposition in early October.
